semiconductor_relevance: High — PTW Semiconductor India specializes in providing innovative solutions for legacy semiconductor manufacturing, focusing on refurbishment and modernization of equipment.
summary: PTW Semiconductor India offers sustainable solutions for semiconductor manufacturing, particularly in the refurbishment and modernization of legacy fabs. Their services include on-site repairs, spare parts refurbishment, and engineering solutions aimed at extending the lifespan and performance of semiconductor equipment.

regional_presence.India: PTW Semiconductor India operates in India, focusing on supporting local semiconductor manufacturing through innovative refurbishment solutions.
